text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic complete hollow outfit, no person, skin or visible mannequin, pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped. Garments: Navy ribbed knit long-sleeve polo with pale mint green pointed collar, cuffs and hem, pearl buttons and small red diamond chest emblem; matching navy drawstring extremely wide lounge trousers with mint piping down sides and round red thigh emblem, navy ivory low-top sneakers. . Add ONLY these accessories: Large slouchy black leather bowling handbag with two rounded handles, dark gothic cross patches and silver hardware; Plain black ribbed knit beanie with folded cuff; Oversized black square optical glasses with clear lenses. No additional accessories or props.
original_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the approved hollow garment ensemble. Preserve its EXACT clothing, layering, silhouette, colors, shoes and material. Input image 2 is original styling reference, ONLY for the accessories listed below. Create one complete styled outfit on a pure uniform WHITE seamless background, portrait 2:3, soft studio light, full uncropped framing. Add ONLY these 3 listed accessories, no other objects: 1. Large slouchy black leather bowling handbag with two rounded handles, dark gothic cross patches and silver hardware; 2. Plain black ribbed knit beanie with folded cuff; 3. Oversized black square optical glasses with clear lenses. Attach those listed accessories naturally to the garment at realistic scale where possible; otherwise display the small listed object neatly adjacent. STRICT: do NOT add any unlisted hat, cap, eyeglasses, sunglasses, handbag, belt, jewelry, props or footwear. No person, skin, body parts, head, face, hands, visible mannequin, stand, text captions or watermark. Empty neckline and sleeves.
